description:
SGP is seeking Proposal Graphic Designers who can translate complex technical and management concepts into clear, compelling visuals that evaluators can easily understand at a glance. You will collaborate with proposal managers, writers, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to develop graphics and layouts that reinforce win themes, while adhering to proposal formatting and page-limit requirements.

You’ll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and be comfortable supporting multiple clients, each with distinct brand standards, templates, and production workflows. You’ll also have experience collaborating with capture managers, proposal managers, proposal coordinators, writers, and editors to develop visuals that effectively communicate solution concepts and align with the overall proposal strategy.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $95 -$110 per hour.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you'll enjoy the independence and flexibility of 1099 work while benefiting from the resources, collaboration, and professional support of an experienced capture and proposals team.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who bring diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize and develop proposal graphics, including process flows, organizational charts, solution architectures, timelines, infographics, and contextual action captions.

  • Translate rough sketches and Subject Matter Expert (SME) input into polished, compliant visuals.

  • Design proposal covers, templates, tabs, and volume layouts.

  • Apply client branding standards and maintain visual consistency across proposal volumes.

  • Develop and refine presentation materials, including oral presentation slide decks and supporting visual or video content, as needed.

  • Incorporate revisions efficiently during color team review and final production.

Required qualifications

  • At least three years of graphic design experience, including a minimum of 2 years supporting federal proposals or similar business development efforts.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud applications (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) and Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.

  • Portfolio demonstrating experience developing proposal graphics or technical business visuals (redacted samples welcome).

  • Ability to meet compressed deadlines and manage multiple requests at once.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience designing graphics and presentation materials for oral proposals and evaluator-facing presentations.

  • Familiarity with proposal formatting requirements, including page limits and font restrictions.

  • Experience with Canva, Figma, or AI-assisted design tools.
